usage.callShape: POST https://x402.orth.sh/olostep/v1/scrapes with JSON body {url_to_scrape, formats?}
usage.outputShape: body.result.markdown_content (also .result.html_content, .result.text_content, .result.json_content; hosted file mirrors at .result.markdown_hosted_url / .result.html_hosted_url etc.; .result.links_on_page[]; .result.page_metadata.status_code)
quirks: Only url_to_scrape is required. formats is a string array e.g. ["markdown","html","text"]; the chosen format populates the matching .result.<fmt>_content field and the others stay null.
Result is nested under body.result, not at top level. Each scrape also gets a hosted S3 URL mirror (e.g. .result.markdown_hosted_url) you can fetch for free.
Synchronous: response returns the scraped content directly with status:200, no polling/job id.
usage.guide: POST to https://x402.orth.sh/olostep/v1/scrapes with a JSON body containing url_to_scrape (required) and optionally formats (e.g. ["markdown"]). Payment is x402 USDC on Base, ~$0.01 per call. The response is synchronous (status 200) with the scraped content under body.result — read body.result.markdown_content (or the *_content field matching your requested format). Optional knobs: remove_images, remove_css_selectors, country, transformer, links_on_page, llm_extract, parser. No auth/sign-in needed.
